verdict.rationale: Outlook is an email service, not an agent, so whether it publishes an official MCP server is a fair question. The pack documents only the Microsoft Graph REST mail APIs and change notifications, which are developer building blocks rather than an MCP server. One community comment mentions searching email through an LLM with an 'MCP/cloud integration', but it never says this is an official Outlook MCP server, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
